scope: B0/B1 controlled party support demo; offline art rendering, not UIKit/device capture
findings: Moved healing/shield floats to right; faces readable at whole-scene scale.
Curved support flow, rally upward streaks, heal tail and shield buildup inspected across decoded sequences.
Revival retains existing lowered defeat body, reverses it continuously; no new lying-flat sprite.
Lethal HP0, damage number and rightward dissolve share result event.
Enemy leading front registered to actual shield surface.
Foreground plants naturally overlap P1 left boot; actor pixels preserved.
limitations: Static decoded sequences inspected; no claim of continuous playback.
Light blending and UI are offline approximations, not exact UIKit/Metal rendering.
Revive/combat use controlled fixtures for fallen player/lethal enemy; not default app starting states.
Two players reuse P1 appearance; deer are training templates, not completed formal monster production.
No App, simulator, physical device or UI execution; target60 is not measured device FPS.
